name: CLERC
description: CLERC is a dataset designed for legal case retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation tasks. It supports training and evaluating models on their ability to find relevant legal citations and generate coherent legal analyses based on those citations.
reputation: A specialized legal retrieval and RAG dataset that is promising for research, but not yet a widely adopted community standard.
notes: Dataset constructed from a large open-source legal corpus; benchmarks show current models struggle with recall and hallucination.
